title: Kissed Springy Irish Goat Meat Wrap
description: A salty and springy Irish dish featuring goat meat, leaf wrapped and steamed to perfection, low in sodium for a healthier option.
instructions: Rinse the collard green leaves and remove the stems.
In a large pot, bring 2 inches of water to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and place a steamer basket over the water.
Add the goat meat, onion, garlic, carrot, and celery to the steamer basket.
Season with black pepper and salt-free seasoning.
Cover the pot with a lid and steam for 20 minutes.
While the meat is steaming, prepare the collard green leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Remove the leaves from the water and let them cool.
To assemble the wraps, place a few pieces of the steamed meat onto the center of a collard green leaf.
Fold the stem end over the meat, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
